description: Deepen Cellar/Loud Room/Deep Canyon physical prose and make the existing chasm pseudo-object consequences materially explicit without changing canonical removal or crossing authority

replacements.old:
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
replacements.new: You are in a dark, damp cellar where cool masonry holds the day's weather at a considerable distance. A narrow passage leads north and a crawlway runs south. To the west, a steep metal ramp rises toward the House; its smooth pitch offers much more slope than purchase.

replacements.old:
This is a large room with a ceiling which cannot be detected from
the ground. There is a narrow passage from east to west and a stone
stairway leading upward.
replacements.new: This is a large stone chamber whose ceiling escapes the useful reach of your light. A narrow passage runs east and west, and a worn stone stairway climbs upward. Hard walls rise on every side, giving the room exactly the architecture an echo would have ordered.

replacements.old:
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon. Passages lead off to the
east, northwest and southwest. A stairway leads down.
replacements.new: You stand on the south edge of a deep underground canyon. Passages leave east, northwest, and southwest, while a stone stairway descends toward the chamber below. The far stone is mostly darkness, and the air at the edge is distinctly cooler.
